study: Decoding the frozen native target-centre seed supervision at final candidate boxes
primary: native_focal_abstain, paired strict oriented Acc@50 against frozen_joint on the previously exposed 192 source-own calibration records, all included
native: Replay one unchanged full-caption forward for all 1024 FP32 logits, seed_xyz and original seed_inds. Preserve historical point draw, all 16 original PCA boxes, birth IDs and joint scores. Recheck 256 historical logits, centers, physical coordinates, IDs, and pre/post checkpoint fingerprint. No extra network call at deployment relative to the normal frozen forward.
coder: Apply official inclusive yawed membership on input points in loader coordinates. Gather with the actual training seed_inds. Rank by native FP32 model-axis normalized distance with both native epsilons, masked sentinel 100, and torch.topk smallest four, followed by background removal. Check native loss targets bit by bit offline, on both the true object and every candidate. Measure actual index-vs-xyz disagreement instead of assuming equivalence. Full 1024 binary labels, no renormalization by positive count.
readouts: Fixed K16. Native group score is the sum over the unique at-most-four positive indices, ordered by ascending ID for reduction. Float64 stable focal negative cost minus positive cost (alpha .25, gamma 2) or raw logit. Top baselines use the up-to-four highest logits anywhere in the same membership mask. Empty sums are zero. Empty max is minus infinity (all empty falls back). Ties use frozen joint score then slot order. Identical codes share scores and use their joint-best representative. Literal maximizes score among physical candidates; abstain selects frozen_joint at max <= 0, including ties with the all-negative code.
mismatch: Permute whole codes of the same cardinality and duplicate count within a frame. Classes of equal cardinality and multiplicity are permuted in a single hash-randomized derangement cycle when at least two distinct codes exist. Random seed is SHA256('seed-code-v1|mismatch|platform|parent-ordinal'). This preserves every slot's code size, code multiset, equivalence partition, number of abstentions and compute. Report all immutable slots and frames, changed code rate and root winner changes.
mechanism: On every row with both hit and miss candidates at .50 report best-good minus best-bad score, sign/ties, per-row macro pairwise win with half credit on ties; secondary .25. Include no-good and all-good cases separately. Compare identities of codes, best possible frozen representative, and actual losses on frozen-missed yet recoverable rows. GT code, score signs and recoverability only post-seal. Partition eligible same-winner, eligible switch and abstention, plus counterfactual literal on abstentions.
statistics: Counts, three equal-sized source panels and mean across them, all 192 anonymous rows. Paired recording-stratified bootstrap within platform (2000, 4287), retaining all rows in each drawn recording. Focus on paired gains and harms. Source panels are previously exposed. With one Drone and few Quad recordings, intervals describe these observations.
decision: Stop if the main arm causes net harm on switches or a substantial precision loss, or if any gains depend entirely on abstention. Check whether correct binding beats the matched wrong binding and high-score physical pooling on the threshold and candidate comparisons. If raw logits perform similarly, only the final-box association could merit follow-up. Dominant unavoidable same-code losses limit claims. Respect uncertain results; do not tune on this panel.
conditional_confirmation: Only proceed if genuine net Acc@50 gains versus frozen and surviving simple/incorrect-pair controls support the mechanism. For confirmation, first select at most 64 per platform from the ordinary source-own VAL recordings disjoint from previous source fits/calibration recordings and physical frames, then use 64 ordinary cross-domain records per direction from recording-disjoint target groups when possible. Select by prespecified SHA256('seed-code-confirm-v1|stage|platform|ordinal'); pair target rows across both sources, disclose exhausted recordings instead of relabelling reused data. Predefine alternate point draws 4101 and 4102 on confirmation, each draw shared by every method with its own frozen readout; never pick the best draw. Use only ordinary filtered rosters; FINAL is excluded. No further head or threshold search.
